column1: # PS-094: FRLG metatile behaviour -> Emerald metatile behaviour (tools/kanto_import/kanto_import.pl).
# Columns: FRLG name (include/constants/metatile_behaviors.h in pokefirered), Emerald name (ours),
# note. A FRLG behaviour whose name exists unchanged in Emerald needs no row (the converter maps it
# by name; the id may differ, e.g. MB_BOOKSHELF 0x81 -> 0xE1, MB_ICE 0x23 -> 0x20). "-" in the
# Emerald column means "no equivalent, needs a handler": the converter reports every referenced
# metatile with it and fails unless --allow-unknown (then MB_NORMAL). PS-096 resolved every "?" of the
# first import: a row's note says what pokefirered does with the behaviour and what happens here.

column3: PS-096: Seafoam Islands B3F/B4F current water (3 metatiles; Sevii has 3025 cells). In pokefirered's engine the behaviour only refuses Surf onto it ("The current is too fast", field_control_avatar.c GetInteractedWaterScript); the ride itself is the maps' scripts (applymovement paths chosen by the player's x, VAR_TEMP_1 set by the fall warp, the *_CURRENT_STOPPED layouts switched by setmaplayoutindex when both boulders sit on the switches) and no scripts are imported, so it is plain surfable water here

PS-096: Route 17 water beside the cycling road (751 cells); pokefirered's engine treats it as surfable water that reflects (MetatileBehavior_IsReflective), nothing else: Emerald's ocean water does both

PS-096: boulder switch (Seafoam Islands / Victory Road, 4 cells). pokefirered runs the coord event's script at the switch when a Strength boulder lands on it (field_control_avatar.c HandleBoulderActivateVictoryRoadSwitch); the boulders are object events and the effect a script, neither is imported, so it is plain floor here (the puzzle is story content)

PS-096: same name here (0x2C): walking and running are slowed down going up or down the stairs, a bike moves at walking-fast speed (field_player_avatar.c PlayerIsMovingOnRockStairs, bike.c), as pokefirered

PS-096: cave floor with sand (pokefirered: MetatileBehavior_IsSand, footprints + land encounters). Emerald's MB_FOOTPRINTS does exactly that (GetGroundEffectFlags_Tracks, HAS_ENCOUNTERS) and no Hoenn metatile uses it

PS-096: same name and id here: spinner tile (Rocket Hideout, Viridian Gym, Team Rocket warehouse), the player spins in that direction across the floor until a stop tile or a wall (field_player_avatar.c TryUpdatePlayerSpinDirection, pokefirered's semantics)
